info.title: voxwerk - Qwen3-TTS (12Hz) text-to-speech in pure C#
info.description: voxwerk: command-line text-to-speech with Qwen3-TTS (voice cloning, voice design, built-in speakers and a catalog of ready-made voices), as a .NET tool. Install with: dotnet tool install -g Voxwerk.Cli

options.name: --text
options.description: Text to speak (or --text-file <path>)

options.name: --voice
options.description: Voice design: natural-language description of the voice (or --voice-file <path>)

options.name: --speaker
options.description: Custom voice: built-in speaker (see `voxwerk speakers`)

options.name: --instruct
options.description: Custom voice: speaking-style instruction (1.7B CustomVoice only)

options.name: --ref
options.description: Reference voice recording (any sample rate, mixed to mono)

options.name: --voice-id
options.description:
Packaged voice (see `voxwerk voices`): synth clones its sample instead of --ref,
design speaks its design prompt instead of --voice

options.name: --ref-text
options.description:
Transcript of the reference (enables ICL mode, best quality)
(or --ref-text-file <path>)

options.name: --x-vector-only
options.description: Clone from the speaker embedding only (no transcript needed)

options.name: --language
options.description: auto (default), english, chinese, german, ...

options.name: --out
options.description: Output WAV (default: out.wav)

options.name: --float32
options.description: Write 32-bit float WAV instead of 16-bit PCM

options.name: --model
options.description: Local model directory or Hugging Face repo id

options.name: --threads
options.description: Worker threads (default: all cores; 1 = single core)

options.name: --int8
options.description: Store talker weights as int8 (≈1.7× faster generation, approximate)

options.name: --greedy
options.description: Deterministic argmax decoding

options.name: --seed
options.description: Random seed

options.name: --temperature
options.description: Talker temperature (0.9)       --top-k <k>      (50)

options.name: --top-p
options.description: Talker top-p (1.0)              --repetition-penalty <r> (1.05)

options.name: --sub-temperature
options.description: Code predictor temperature (0.9) --sub-top-k <k> (50)

options.name: --max-frames
options.description: Max generated 12.5 Hz frames (2048)

options.name: --non-streaming
options.description: Put the full text in the prompt (default for design / custom)

options.name: --streaming
options.description: Stream the text alongside generation (default for synth)
